RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 60

An all-male panel is common in engineering leadership due to demographic skew, so it is not definitive proof of discrimination on its own. However, selecting a candidate with roughly half your technical tenure based on subjective "client relationships" frequently reflects unconscious affinity bias.

Do not lead with accusations of sexism, as doing so without concrete documentation will likely prompt defensive stonewalling and burn professional bridges. Instead, follow up on your requested debrief by asking for specific, objective scoring metrics across the shortlist. If they refuse to provide justification, or if the process clearly violated hiring protocols, consult an employment attorney or HR to assess raising formal concerns.
